content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Licenses voice AI software to automakers; it does not run a vehicle marketplace or sell dealer listings and advertising."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Runs salvage and total-loss vehicle auctions and yards for insurers; different products, sellers and earning model from dealer listings."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Sells insurance quote leads to carriers and agencies per lead; a different business from auto dealer listings and software."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Owns consumer lifestyle and health media brands monetized through ads and affiliate commissions, not dealer marketplace subscriptions."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Publishes local newspapers and commercial printing; print and news subscriptions differ fundamentally from automotive listings and dealer software."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Diversified news, book publishing and property portals; its real estate listings do not match automotive marketplace and dealer software."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Wholesale vehicle auctions and floorplan lending sell used vehicles to dealers; not listing or software subscriptions, so a different business model."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Sells fleet telematics hardware and tracking software to fleet operators; different products and customers from dealer marketplace services."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Content recommendation and native ad-tech platform for publishers and advertisers; no automotive marketplace or dealer software overlap."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Publishes sports, lifestyle and finance magazines and websites monetized through advertising and affiliate links; a media business, not auto marketplace."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Programmatic ad-buying software for brands and agencies; sells media buying technology, not automotive listings or dealer subscriptions."}]}
